What we do, and how we do it.

A five-phase delivery approach with named deliverables, client inputs, review points, and an operating handover. Start with a pilot, then scale what works.

  1. 1

    Discover

    1–2 weeks

    We walk the journey with pre-sales, sales, CRM, finance, legal, leasing or site teams, map where leads, documents, approvals and site information stall, and review what the CRM, ERP, portals and site apps can expose. We also review consent wording, partner policies, ad approval practice and the RERA details for each project.

    Deliverables

    • Journey map with failure points for each segment you operate
    • Systems and data inventory, including portal lead delivery options
    • Consent, TRAI, WhatsApp and RERA advertising gap review
    • Prioritized automation backlog with effort ranges

    What we need from you

    • CRM and ERP administrator access or vendor contacts, and portal account manager contacts
    • RERA registration details, approved price sheets, brochures and payment plans for each project
    • Channel partner policy, brokerage slabs and approval limits in writing
    • Named owners: sales head, CRM head, finance controller, legal and, for contractors, project and safety heads
  2. 2

    Design

    1–2 weeks

    We design conversation flows, templates, routing and approval rules, document templates and data flows. Price, legal and safety content is written or approved by your team, and every message type is mapped to its consent basis and channel rules.

    Deliverables

    • Conversation flows and template drafts for WhatsApp approval and DLT registration
    • Approval matrices for demands, payouts, discounts and material requests
    • Data flow diagram with retention and access for each field
    • Owner and escalation matrix, including safety escalation for sites

    What we need from you

    • Consent and privacy notice wording reviewed by your legal or compliance owner
    • Legal sign-off on allotment, agreement, demand and notice templates
    • WhatsApp Business account, display name and DLT entity registration access
  3. 3

    Build

    2–4 weeks

    We build the integrations in n8n and the agreed tools against test data, set up the consent log, partner and buyer portals, staff queues and dashboards, and document every connection and credential owner.

    Deliverables

    • Working integrations in a test environment
    • Consent and outreach preference log
    • Portals, staff queues and dashboards
    • Integration documentation and access list

    What we need from you

    • Test or sandbox access to the CRM, ERP and site apps
    • Sample leads, payment plans, leases or BOQs with personal data removed
    • Staff time for weekly build reviews
  4. 4

    Validate & launch

    1–2 weeks

    We test with sales, CRM, finance and site users, run scripted edge cases such as duplicate partner claims, a demand before a registered agreement, a discount request outside the band and a serious site incident, fix what fails and launch on one project, center or site first.

    Deliverables

    • Test report including edge-case script results
    • Go-live checklist and rollback plan
    • Staff training and quick reference guides
    • Operating runbook

    What we need from you

    • Go-live approval from the sales or project head and the data protection contact
    • Staff available for training and the first live week
  5. 5

    Operate & improve

    Ongoing, with monthly reviews

    We monitor failed messages, template quality ratings, response times, approval delays and AI accuracy, review KPIs with your owners every month, and change templates, rules and prompts only through an approved change process.

    Deliverables

    • Monthly KPI and quality review
    • Failure and incident log with fixes
    • Quarterly access and retention review
    • Change log for templates, rules and prompts

    What we need from you

    • Named owner for change approvals
    • Monthly review time with sales, finance and site leads

First pilot: Four-week lead-to-site-visit pilot on one project

Start with one project and its main lead sources: leads are deduplicated, answered with approved content and the RERA number, qualified and assigned with response-time alerts, and visits are booked, reminded and checked in on WhatsApp. We compare response time and visit show-up with the weeks before in your CRM, and track visit-to-booking as bookings follow. Contractors can start with daily site reports instead.

  • One project with portal, Meta or Google and website lead sources connected to the CRM
  • Approved WhatsApp templates and a qualification Flow carrying the RERA registration number
  • Assignment rules, response-time alerts and a named sales manager for escalations
  • Site visit booking, reminders and gallery QR check-in
  • Baseline and pilot comparison of response time and visit show-up, with visit-to-booking tracked after the pilot

Ways to work together

Choose the engagement that fits your stage.

  • Pilot sprint

    One automation, one segment and one accountable owner. We build, validate and measure it against agreed acceptance criteria before anything wider is committed.

    Best for: Proving value and fit with low risk

  • Phased rollout

    A prioritized roadmap across the journey, released in reviewed increments, with training and documentation after each release.

    Best for: Teams ready to connect several workflows

  • Operate & improve

    Monthly reviews of measures and exceptions, template and rule updates, and new automations as priorities change, during business hours.

    Best for: Keeping automations accurate as the business changes

Safe by design, owned by your team

  • Approved sources only: automated answers come from approved price sheets, brochures, RERA project pages and FAQs with named owners; offers, possession dates and legal or tax questions always go to a person.
  • Consent and preferences first: every outreach rests on recorded consent, a WhatsApp opt-in or an enquiry inside TRAI's seven-day window, DND preferences are checked before promotional calls, and STOP or do-not-call requests end outreach on every channel.
  • People approve money, contracts and safety: allotments, agreements, demand batches, interest, payouts, discounts, bid prices and escalations each have a named approver, and serious site incidents reach the safety officer by phone at once.
  • Least-privilege access: partners see only their own clients, contractors never see buyer contacts, KYC files are encrypted with Aadhaar numbers masked, and access is reviewed every quarter.
  • Logs and breach readiness: processing logs are kept for at least one year, as the DPDP Rules require from May 2027, and an incident runbook supports notice to affected people without delay and a detailed report to the Board within seventy-two hours.
  • Controlled change: templates, prompts and rules are versioned, tested against scripted edge cases and approved by their named owner before each release.

The obligations that shape the design

Implementation notes, not legal advice. Your legal or compliance owner confirms how each obligation applies to your organization.

  • RERA: project and agent registration, and advertisements

    Under the RERA Act 2016, a project that must register cannot be advertised, marketed, booked or sold before registration, every ad must prominently show the registration number and the authority's website, and agents must register and must not facilitate unregistered projects. States add detail: MahaRERA requires a scannable QR code beside the number on promoters' and agents' ads, with size norms updated in 2025, and a certificate of competency for agents.

    maharera.maharashtra.gov.in · Source

  • RERA: advance limit, quarterly disclosure and defect liability

    A promoter may not take more than ten percent of a unit's cost as an advance or application fee before a written agreement for sale is registered, must update bookings, approvals and construction status on the authority's website every quarter, and must fix structural and workmanship defects reported within five years of possession. Our booking, update and snag workflows are designed around these duties; state rules and formats vary.

    indiacode.nic.in · Source

  • Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 and DPDP Rules 2025

    Buyer, tenant, partner and worker data is personal data under the DPDP Act. The Rules, notified in November 2025, phase in to May 2027, though MeitY has consulted on earlier dates: itemized notices, consent as easy to withdraw as to give, security safeguards with logs kept for a year, and breach notice to affected people without delay and to the Board within seventy-two hours. Bought lead lists need a documented basis.

    meity.gov.in · Source

  • TRAI rules for calls and SMS, and WhatsApp messaging policy

    Calls and SMS follow TRAI's TCCCPR 2018 as amended in 2025 and September 2026: DLT-registered headers and templates, promotional calls only from 140-series numbers, no telemarketing from ordinary mobile numbers, and DND preferences, where real estate can be blocked. Messages based only on a customer's enquiry are limited to seven days, with the enquiry kept in verifiable form. WhatsApp needs an opt-in naming the business and approved templates outside the 24-hour window.

    trai.gov.in · Source

  • Prevention of Money Laundering Act duties for real estate agents

    Real estate agents as defined under RERA with annual turnover of twenty lakh rupees or more are notified as reporting entities under the PMLA, with CBIC named as their regulator. Duties include registering with FIU-IND, appointing a Principal Officer and Designated Director, verifying clients and beneficial owners, keeping records for five years and reporting suspicious transactions without tipping off the client. Confirm current thresholds and duties with your advisers.

    fiuindia.gov.in · Source

  • Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code 2020

    The OSH Code came into force on 21 November 2025 and subsumes the Building and Other Construction Workers Act 1996. Central Rules were notified in May 2026, while most private sites follow state rules issued on each state's timeline. Construction work with ten or more workers brings duties such as registration, prescribed registers and returns, and prompt notice of deaths, serious injuries and dangerous occurrences such as a structure collapse.

    pib.gov.in · Source

Frequently asked

Will an AI assistant quote prices, offers or possession dates to our buyers?

No. Automated replies cover amenities, location, carpet areas, price ranges and documents only from content your team approves, including the RERA registration and project details. Specific prices come from the approved price sheet through your executive, and offers, discounts, payment-plan changes, possession dates and legal questions always go to a person. Your sales head and legal team approve the knowledge base and templates before launch.

Do we need to replace our CRM, ERP or site software?

No. We connect to the systems you already run, such as Sell.Do, LeadSquared, Salesforce or Zoho CRM, Farvision, SAP or Tally, Yardi or Nexudus, and site apps, through their APIs, webhooks or approved exports. Where a system has no interface, we agree a safe interim route and state its limits. Your existing systems stay the source of truth.

Can we message portal leads on WhatsApp straight away?

Only where the person has opted in to messages from your business. WhatsApp requires an opt-in that names the business and approved templates outside the 24-hour service window. Where a portal or form does not capture that opt-in, the assigned executive calls first and offers it. Calls and SMS follow TRAI rules: 140-series numbers for promotional calls, DLT-registered templates, the customer's real estate preference, and a seven-day limit on follow-up that relies only on the enquiry, after which recorded consent is needed.

How do you settle channel partner disputes?

We do not; your policy does. We turn your written rules, such as registration validity and what counts as a direct lead, into checks that timestamp every registration, visit and contact. Possible conflicts go to your channel partner manager with the full evidence timeline, and partners only ever see their own clients.

Many of our buyers are NRIs. What changes?

Messages and follow-ups are scheduled in the buyer's local daytime, video site visits overlap with Indian working hours, and answers on eligibility and payments come only from an FAQ your legal team approves. Under RBI rules, NRIs and OCIs may buy property other than agricultural land, plantations and farmhouses, paying through banking channels or NRE, FCNR or NRO accounts. For buyers in the EU or UK the GDPR or UK GDPR may also apply, and Meta ads aimed at audiences in the US, Canada or parts of Europe may fall under its housing special ad category.

We are a contractor, not a developer. Is this relevant to us?

Yes. Contractors usually start with RFQ and BOQ intake or one daily site report covering progress, labor and material requests, then add safety incident logging and snag rectification for clients. Site forms work offline on ordinary Android phones and sync when the connection returns, and approvals follow your own value limits.

How long does a first project take, and what drives the cost?

A first pilot usually runs three to six weeks, depending mainly on CRM and portal access and template approvals. We quote after discovery, once your systems, volumes and existing licenses are known. Provider charges such as WhatsApp messaging, SMS, telephony and model usage are billed by those providers and shown separately.

Who owns the buyer, partner and site data?

You do. We set up messaging, database and automation accounts in your organization's name wherever the provider allows, limit our access to named people for named tasks, and hand over credentials, documentation and workflows at the end of the engagement.
